\newcount\CFformatted
\newcount\CFmiddlecalls
\newwrite\CFwritten
\immediate\openout\CFwritten=\jobname.nodes
\let\CFformat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\CFformatted by1
  \write\CFwritten{ENTRY #1}%
  \CFformat{#1}}
\AddToHook{shipout/before}{\ifnum\value{page}>30 \errmessage{Too many pages}\fi}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{CF-FORMATTED \the\CFformatted}}

\usepackage{graphicx}

\makeatletter
\newcount\LIcalls
\newcount\LIcontcalls
\newcount\LIaccepts
\newcount\LImeasurements
\def\LIerror#1{\PackageError{lifecycle-inner-direct}{#1}{Inner direct output must keep direct ownership and formatting.}}
\let\LIfirst\dte@dosplit@first
\def\dte@dosplit@first{%
  \ifinner\else\LIerror{Direct first output was not inner}\fi
  \global\advance\LIcalls by1
  \LIfirst
  \ifnum\dte@defercount=0\else\LIerror{Inner output did not reset deferral}\fi
  \ifvoid\dte@framebox\else\LIerror{Direct inner output left unconsumed rows}\fi}
\let\LIcont\dte@dosplit@cont
\def\dte@dosplit@cont{%
  \ifinner\else\LIerror{Direct continuation was not inner}\fi
  \global\advance\LIcontcalls by1
  \LIcont}
\let\LIaccept\dte@acceptsplit
\def\dte@acceptsplit{%
  \ifinner\else\LIerror{Inner remainder transfer lost its mode}\fi
  \global\advance\LIaccepts by1
  \LIaccept}
\let\LImeasure\dte@measurepiece
\def\dte@measurepiece#1{%
  \global\advance\LImeasurements by1\LImeasure{#1}}
\let\LIsingle\dte@measure@single
\def\dte@measure@single{%
  \global\advance\LImeasurements by1\LIsingle}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifnum\LIcalls=1\else\LIerror{Missing direct first path}\fi
  \ifnum\LIcontcalls>0\else\LIerror{Missing direct continuation}\fi
  \ifnum\LIaccepts=1\else\LIerror{Missing direct copied-remainder acceptance}\fi
  \ifnum\LImeasurements=0\else\LIerror{Direct path acquired measured-picture trials}\fi
  \ifnum\CFformatted=61\else\LIerror{Inner semantic rows lost or rebuilt}\fi
  \typeout{LI-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED first=\the\LIcalls;continuations=\the\LIcontcalls;accepts=\the\LIaccepts;measurements=\the\LImeasurements;rows=\the\CFformatted}}
\makeatother
